title: Lie down as dead. Stare without blinking. Suck something and become the sucking.
caption:
Anger, fear, sadness. They are called emotions because they create motion in the body. What if you simply did not move?

Technique 9 of 112. Lie down as if dead. Whatever arises in the mind, stay so. Look at anxiety without being moved by it, and you become the master.

Save this and try it for three minutes tonight.

Technique and sutra from Osho, The Book of Secrets.

.
